title: Growing up · speaking rehearsal
intro_questions: What experience do you have of this topic?
Has your view changed over time?
cue: Describe someone in your family or a friendship that has influenced you.
points: what or who you are describing
when and how you first experienced it
details or examples that make the description clear
why it matters to you
followups: How might other people have different needs or preferences?
What advantages and difficulties can arise?
How could the situation change in the future?
checks: I answered directly and developed the ideas.
I used vocabulary with an appropriate sense and form.
I linked a reason with a relevant example.
I paraphrased and corrected myself when needed.
